summary: Thai Law and Accounting Services is a Khon Kaen accounting firm offering company setup, BOI, bookkeeping, tax, payroll and visa and work permit paperwork for foreign-owned businesses.

facts.label: Visa and work permits
facts.value: English-speaking desk handles visa and work permit paperwork for foreign-owned companies
facts.quote: Our English-speaking desk handles accounting, tax, payroll and the official filings foreign-owned companies need

facts.label: Work permits
facts.value: Corporate setup, BOI, FBL and work permits
facts.quote: Full-scope corporate setup, BOI promotion, Foreign Business Licenses (FBL), work permits, bilingual bookkeeping, and cross-border tax compliance across Thailand.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Head office on Na Mueang Road, Khon Kaen, with a Bangkok branch
facts.quote: Our head office is at 680/45 Na Mueang Road, Khon Kaen, with a Bangkok branch on Soi Lat Phrao 95.

facts.label: Offices
facts.value: Offices in Khon Kaen, Bangkok, Udon Thani and Nong Khai
facts.quote: We operate 4 offices: Khon Kaen (head office), Bangkok, Udon Thani, and Nong Khai, serving clients nationwide.
